verdict.rationale: Gemini's own help docs say users can upload documents and spreadsheets to get answers, summaries, and insights, and Deep Research also accepts uploaded files. A community report of replacing an OCR vendor for PDF ingestion (about 96% of the vendor's accuracy) supports accuracy on PDFs, but it describes API use rather than the consumer upload flow, so the story's PDF and accuracy elements are only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit first-party mention of PDF upload support, documented accuracy or limits (file size, page counts, spreadsheet formula handling), and hands-on corroboration of analysis accuracy in the Gemini app itself.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: You can upload documents, spreadsheets, notebooks, photos, videos, and more to Gemini Apps to get answers, summaries, and insights about your content.
You can also upload files and add NotebookLM notebooks.
we replaced an OCR vendor with Gemini at work for ingesting some PDFs... Processing time went from something like 12 minutes on average to 6s on average, accuracy was like 96% of that of the vendor
